column1: # ERROR_CODES.tsv — complete exception taxonomy of Kathara v3.8.3 (kathara-python) for the Go port.
# Paths are relative to kathara-python/src/Kathara/ unless prefixed. "lab-checker:" = /root/kathara/kathara-lab-checker/src/kathara_lab_checker/.
# Message variants within one cell are separated by " || ". Messages are exact f-string/%-format templates from source.
#   1. Catch-all in KatharaEntryPoint.__init__ around command_object.run(): `except Exception as e:` ->
#      logging.exception(...) with the same "({type}) {msg}" format plus traceback. So the observable stderr line is e.g.
#      "CRITICAL (MachineNotFoundError) Device `pc1` not found." and the process exit code is 1.
#   2. Startup settings check: `except (SettingsError, DockerDaemonConnectionError)` -> same "({type}) {msg}" critical, exit 1.
#   3. Unknown command (ClassNotFoundError from CommandFactory): logging.error(f"Unrecognized command `{args.command}`.") + print_help, exit 1.
#   4. ImportError from CommandFactory: logging.critical(f"({type(e).__name__}) `{e.name}` is not installed in your system"), exit 1.
#   5. KeyboardInterrupt: warning ("You interrupted Kathara during a command...`kathara wipe`." unless command in [exec, linfo, list, settings]), exit 0.
#   6. argparse.ArgumentTypeError / argparse usage errors: argparse prints usage+error to stderr, exit 2.
#   7. No/invalid command: print_help, exit 1. --version: print version, exit 0. `exec` returns the remote command's exit code; `check` returns 1 on failed self-test.
#   In the Go port (spec §5.1/§5.3): human mode reproduces "({Code}) {msg}" on stderr; json mode emits {"error":{"code":...,"message":...}} on stdout, exit non-zero.
# exit_code_observed legend: 1 = escapes to kathara.py catch-all (exit 1); 2 = argparse; 0 = KeyboardInterrupt path; "-" = never escapes to CLI (caught/internal).
